function.description: Replace an exact, unique string in a file (fails loudly on 0 or >1 matches unless replace_all)
function.name: coding_str_replace

coerced_note.description: Set when old/new_string were coerced from an object.

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative to the workspace, or absolute within it)

new_string.description: Replacement text (a JSON object is coerced to its compact single line)

old_string.description: Exact text to replace; must be unique unless replace_all=true. For a JSONL row pass the row's exact text (a JSON object is coerced to its compact line).

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of failing on ambiguity
